text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: This is a non-review research paper focused primarily on spatial prediction of land use and land cover (LULC) changes in China at the national scale. The study develops and applies a coupled LUH2-PLUS-InVEST framework to simulate LULC changes at 500 m resolution across China from 2025 to 2050 under multiple future SSP-RCP scenarios (SSP245, SSP370, SSP585). The paper includes quantitative accuracy assessment of the LULC simulations (overall accuracy ~94%, Kappa 0.92), presents spatially explicit mapped projections, and compares multiple scenarios quantitatively. The LULC prediction is central to the study and is coupled with carbon storage estimation, but LULC prediction is clearly the primary modeling focus. The study meets all core inclusion criteria: explicit national-scale spatial implementation, primary focus on LULC prediction, use of multiple future scenarios with quantitative comparison, spatial modeling with accuracy metrics, and mapped LULC outputs. It does not meet any exclusion criteria. Therefore, it qualifies as OK.
